definitions.gloss: cinders; burnt remains; embers; residue after burning
definitions.explanation: The solid residue left after something has been burned, such as ash, cinders, or charred remains. Also used figuratively to describe something that has been exhausted or spent.

examples.japanese: たき{火|び}の{燃|も}え{殻|がら}を{片付|かたづ}ける。
examples.english: To clean up the cinders from the bonfire.

examples.japanese: ストーブの{燃|も}え{殻|がら}を{処分|しょぶん}する。
examples.english: To dispose of the burnt remains from the stove.

examples.japanese: {火事|かじ}の{後|あと}、{建物|たてもの}には{燃|も}え{殻|がら}と{灰|はい}だけが{残|のこ}っていた。
examples.english: After the fire, only cinders and ash remained of the building.

notes:
A compound of {燃|も}え (the stem of {燃|も}える, to burn) and {殻|がら} (shell, husk, remains). The {殻|がら} element appears in other compounds with the meaning of 'leftover remains,' such as {吸|す}い{殻|がら} (cigarette butt).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燃|も}え{殻|がら}を{片付|かたづ}ける: to clean up cinders
- {燃|も}え{殻|がら}を{処分|しょぶん}する: to dispose of burnt remains
- {石炭|せきたん}の{燃|も}え{殻|がら}: coal cinders
- {燃|も}え{殻|がら}が{残|のこ}る: cinders remain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {灰|はい}: ash — finer residue after burning, lighter than cinders
- {吸|す}い{殻|がら}: cigarette butt — the remains of a smoked cigarette, uses the same {殻|がら}
- {残骸|ざんがい}: wreckage, remains — broader term for ruins or remains of anything destroyed
- {炭|すみ}: charcoal — partially burned wood that can still be used as fuel
